title: GSP III Schedule Update
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.NATIONAL GEOSPATIAL-INTELLIGENCE AGENCY (NGA).ATTN: MS S84 - OCS
detail_text: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) is anticipating the release of a Draft RFP for GSP III within the next two weeks on the Classified ARC (https://acq.nro.ic.gov). Interested parties should check back regularly for updates. Offerors must register to create an account on the Classified ARC to access Classified Solicitations. Contact the ACE Helpdesk at secure 855-4ACE or unclassified 703-230-6300. It may take up to 48 hours for a classified account to be established.
